KoppaSansVF.subset.woff2 is a modified version of Mona Sans 2.0.27
(https://github.com/github/mona-sans, file MonaSansVF[wdth,opsz,wght].woff2
from mona-sans-webfonts-v2.0.27.zip).

Changes: subset to Latin, Latin-1, general punctuation, arrows and geometric
shapes with fontTools pyftsubset; stylistic sets dropped; all variation axes
kept. Because "Mona" is a Reserved Font Name, the family is renamed to
"Koppa Sans" as required by the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see OFL.txt).
Copyright and license notices are unchanged.
